analysis: The only changed file is docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch adds one documentation paragraph (head lines ~595-611) describing a Gated DeltaNet four-row recurrence kernel for qwen3_5, qwen3_5_moe and prism_hadamard_qwen35 models. Per the doc, a per-process, per-kernel-instantiation probe tries the `packed` and then the `rows` kernel on a fixed probe window and keeps the first that reproduces `gated_delta_step` bit for bit, otherwise it falls back to the stock kernel. Decode, MTP verification, masked updates and short windows stay on the stock kernel. DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED controls forcing for A/B measurement. No code, config, endpoint or control was changed in this unit, so no security regression is observable here. Possible interactions for later review: (1) the claimed bit-exactness underpins prefix-cache checkpoint capture (T-041, A-001); if the actual kernel diverged, recurrent state used in cross-chunk checkpoints could differ, which is a correctness concern rather than a confidentiality one. (2) The probe uses a fixed window, so it carries no consumer data. (3) The DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED env override is operator-local and creates no new trust boundary. The kernel source (GatedDelta.swift) was not supplied, so the doc's claims are unverified. The base-side text excerpt is unrelated surrounding content, and the head excerpt shows only unchanged context. I found no threat-model update needed.
